hero.heading: Clear Bra & Paint Protection Film in Boulder City, NV
hero.intro: Paint protection film is not for every vehicle. If you keep a car in the garage and only drive it to shows, you may never need it. For anything that spends real time on Nevada highways, gravel shoulders and desert wind, it is a different story: rock chips and road debris hit the front end first, and clear bra absorbs that impact instead of your paint. It is a self-healing, nearly invisible film, computer-cut to your vehicle's panels, backed by a lifetime manufacturer warranty and installed at our Boulder City shop for drivers from Henderson to Las Vegas.
